figures.caption: Figure 1 Memento detailed design diagram. Left:Memento Retrieval Stage Query patterns generate retrieval queries from ad requests; Memento indices organize user history into retrievable documents and retrieves through MMR; Right: Application as Representation and DataMemento. The application gives specific requirements through query and context, producing augmented user context for the ranking models in CTR/CVR prediction model
Figure 2 Retention scaling comparison: LastN linear scaling vs. RAG-style scaling for CTR (bottom) and CVR (top) models. Lower NE% indicates better performance relative to baseline.

Table 2 Representation Memento experiments with different configurations. NE values are relative to the baseline (no Memento); negative indicates improvement. Inference QPS shows percentage change from baseline (negative indicates fewer queries served). Storage is in number of float-equivalent values per user.
